title: Jarvis Receipt Journal Entry
description: Sanitized, public receipt metadata for a bounded Jarvis remote-control command envelope. This schema enumerates the ONLY fields that may ever appear in a public receipt-journal entry. Commands, credentials, tokens, environment data, Host Ops internals, and any other private artifact are strictly forbidden. The authoritative raw receipt lives privately in pixenetwork/ai-orchestrator and is referenced here only by a one-way hash (rawHashRef).

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this receipt-journal entry. Structural metadata only; carries no receipt content.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase of the command envelope that this receipt attests. Enumerated; never free-form text.

nonce.description: The 128-bit envelope nonce, expressed as exactly 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Matches the nonce field of the referenced command envelope. Non-secret, single-use anti-replay value.

rawHashRef.description: One-way reference to the authoritative private raw receipt. Format: 'sha256:' followed by exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This is a pointer only; the raw receipt content itself is never published here.

ttlSeconds.description: Time-to-live of the command envelope in whole seconds, as originally issued. Bounded positive integer; conveys validity window duration only, not absolute timestamps or host clock data.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome recorded for the referenced phase. Enumerated; never free-form text.
